status: measured from two photos on a SKÅDIS pegboard, not calipered
source: IMG_1876 (near-frontal) + IMG_1879 (43 deg oblique), iPhone 17e main camera 26 mm equiv. Pegboard slot grid 40 x 40 mm plus a copy offset 20, 20 fitted as a homography per photo, camera pose from the known focal length, depth by two-view triangulation, edges projected onto the solved board plane
pcb_thickness_note: typical laptop board, not measured. fit-gauge slots 1.2-1.8 settle it
stack_top_note: heatsink side, derived: 11.4 panel-to-shield minus 1.2 PCB minus about 2 for the shield, assuming the heatsink rests on the panel under the bungee cords
stack_bottom_note: shield side, shield face about 2 mm off the PCB plus margin
port_edges: both short edges carry ports. Photo-left edge (-X in the scene) 2-3 connectors, photo-right edge (+X) 6 connectors incl. audio
photo: board-top.png, heatsink side on the PCB plane, true scale, written by skadis-measure.py --ortho, not in this repo

fans.note: GPU blower bay is empty in IMG_1565/1566. Replacements list both numbers for MS-16W1, 9S and 10S GF65 Thin

accuracy: cross-checked edges agree between the two photos within 1.5 mm. Length +/-3 mm, width +/-1.5 mm. Depth of the shield face +/-1.7 mm
length_note: heatsink fin stack left face to port-edge PCB right edge. DC and HDMI port faces on the left sit within a few mm of the fins, hidden behind the plugs
width_note: PCB edge to PCB edge across the short axis
heatsink_overhang_note: heatsink fin stack past the PCB edge on the side opposite the M.2 slots
ssd_protrusion_note: two M.2 2280 cards stick out 74.0 mm past the PCB edge on the M.2 side, unsupported. The chassis carried their screw ends; the enclosure has to
ssd_span_note: along the length from the heatsink face: 256.2-278.6 and 280.2-302.2, 1.6 mm apart

shield.height_note: outer top lip to the middle bottom edge, the lower-left lobe reaches about 125

derivation: skadis-measure.py in the cad repo reproduces every measured value here from the two source photos, not in this repo

outline.frame: board-local mm: origin at the board centre (midway heatsink face to port edge, midway PCB edge to PCB edge), +X toward the 6-connector port edge, +Y toward the M.2 edge, heatsink side up. Panel mm from skadis-measure.py minus (-42.395, -140.945)
outline.source: read off board-shield.png (not in this repo) on a 1 mm grid, +/-1 mm. Main extremes are the measured edges above
outline.pcb_note: notch 85.4-148.0 on the -Y edge is where the heatpipe stubs run. The top-left corner behind the heatsink block is not visible and left out
outline.shield_note: stamped plate on the PCB underside. The two lobes on the +Y edge overhang the PCB edge by 12.2 mm; openings are traced from the photo into board-ortho.json

heatsink.note: boxes as [min corner, max corner] in plan, on the heatsink side. Fin stacks overhang the PCB outline

ports.note: port bodies from the photo +/-2 mm along the edge. Face x from the photo; heights are typical part heights on the heatsink side, not measured
